annotations.title: Premium Bonds vs a Savings Account

description: What a typical (median) year of Premium Bond prizes is on an amount - most holders win less than the prize fund rate - against a savings account's interest after tax, and the savings rate that beats it. Use for 'are Premium Bonds worth it on £20k', 'what savings rate beats Premium Bonds'.

amount.description: The amount, in pounds: Premium Bonds hold £25 to £50,000.

otherIncome.description: Salary, pension, rent - income other than savings interest, a year, in pounds. It sets the tax on interest.

savingsRatePct.description: A savings account's rate to compare, as an AER, e.g. 4. Optional - the break-even rate is given either way.
